name: skynetos
description: An overhead pixel-art motherboard that is a real control surface for every project run with Claude.
author: Goob Entertainment Co.

scripts.build: npm run verify && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run validate:board && npm run assets:bake && npm run validate:assets && npm run test

$deps: Native modules (better-sqlite3, node-pty, keytar) are in optionalDependencies ON PURPOSE.
They need a node-gyp toolchain this machine does not have, and nothing before M3 imports them.
npm install therefore succeeds with them omitted instead of rolling the whole tree back.
M3 must resolve the toolchain properly (@electron/rebuild against Electron's ABI, or a
WASM/built-in sqlite swap) and promote them back to dependencies. See docs/DECISIONS.md.
